description: Declarative automation rules for the Autonomous NOC. Rules react to EventBus topics and run actions. No rule executes shell commands: 'command' actions are queued for a later, security-reviewed executor.

rules.name: Critical alert → notify + webhook
rules.description: Any newly created critical alert is recorded locally and pushed to the on-call webhook.

rules.name: Sustained latency breach → notify + remediation
rules.description: Latency above 500ms for three consecutive snapshots (~6s) queues a remediation command instead of executing it.

rules.name: Prometheus unreachable → notify + webhook
rules.description: The NOC is flying blind when Prometheus cannot be reached; escalate the alert off-host.

rules.name: Alert resolved → notify
rules.description: Records every alert recovery in the automation run history so the dashboard can show the full lifecycle.
